scope: Adaptive public budget, funded current public work and 600-month controlled comparison

browser.history_selection: Month 15 shows a public job cut effective month 16.

figure.visual_review: Eight comparison panels checked, common legend outside data.

limitations: Illustrative expenditure-side policy, not empirical calibration or a recommendation.
Removal of current wage arrears is achieved through fewer authorized public jobs; existing claims are not cancelled.
Higher cumulative household purchases do not measure public-service value or overall welfare.
Unfunded social reference needs rise and the credit limit is eventually reached in the adaptive run.
